name: rorkassa-app
description: Rørkassa som iPhone-app (Capacitor). Appen viser rorkassa.net.

scripts.forbered: mkdir -p www && cp offline.html www/offline.html && cp start.html www/index.html
scripts.ios:lag: npm run forbered && npx cap add ios && bash ios-oppsett.sh
scripts.ios:oppdater: npm run forbered && npx cap sync ios
